en.flavor: A cheap fantasy novel with no value whatsoever. Any claim that it possesses the power of catalysis is also pure fantasy.

refinements.2: Each Elemental Orb or Particle collected restores <r>1.25%</r> HP.
refinements.3: Each Elemental Orb or Particle collected restores <r>1.5%</r> HP.
refinements.4: Each Elemental Orb or Particle collected restores <r>1.75%</r> HP.
refinements.5: Each Elemental Orb or Particle collected restores <r>2%</r> HP.
